title: Keyboard-first review
desc: A one-item-at-a-time queue tuned for hour-long sessions: class letters, Enter to confirm, Z to undo, N to skip — every action is a single keystroke.

title: Cluster-assisted labeling
desc: Crops the backend has grouped by visual similarity are triaged as a batch: bulk confirm, drag-and-drop onto class rows, refine into sub-clusters.

title: Client-drawn provenance
desc: Every box — item and region — is drawn client-side from served coordinates, with full detector/verifier chain, rejection reasons and OCR text overlays.

title: Any domain, one backend flag
desc: Cropwright ships with no domain built in. The backend's served region profile drives the whole region UI automatically — vehicles, defects, tags, or nothing at all.

title: Training cockpit
desc: Launch preflight-checked training runs, watch live progress and logs, review test-split evaluation and lineage, then promote to the model registry.

title: Model comparison
desc: Bake-off compares trained and baseline models across evaluation datasets in one run — a model x dataset matrix with served winners bolded.

title: Ingest at scale
desc: Browser upload or server-path batch ingest, chunked and resumable, with per-file results and a region-drain gate before the next clustering pass.

title: Multiple projects, one deployment
desc: Each project keeps its own classes, data, settings and shortcuts under its own `/p/<project>` URL, switchable from the top bar, with pause, archive, copy-settings and a guarded delete.

title: Import and Reprocess
desc: Bring in an already-labeled dataset with a served preview and by-name class mapping, review it on its own tab, and re-run machine proposals without overwriting human work.

title: Edit the VLM and region setup in-app
desc: Prompt-pack and region-profile editors with live validation, revisions, rollback and test-on-a-crop, plus a VLM endpoint registry with per-run selection. API keys are never shown.

title: Multi-box regions
desc: Any number of boxes per item, each with its own state, accepted or rejected with one key, and a lock on anything a human has set.

title: Combine and share
desc: Merge several projects into a new one with a previewed class mapping and an undo, and share trained models between projects by class name.

title: Rebind every shortcut
desc: A per-project keyboard-shortcut editor with verb groups, per-page overrides, locked keys and server-side conflict checks.
